steps.action: Install this release from the Melusina store, create a new CyberTeller grain through the normal app action, and open it as the signed-in grain owner.
steps.expectedResult: The grain launches and redirects to the page headed "Admin Dashboard" with the subheading "Operations console · crypto payment processor". It renders a "First-launch setup" card marked "3 steps" and does not show a blank page, process-failure curtain, or an operational payment console.

steps.action: Read the first-launch card without submitting any form or granting any capability.
steps.expectedResult: Step 1 is headed "Connect the admin Solana wallet", is marked "Required", and offers an "Admin wallet public key (base58)" field plus "Build challenge to sign". The page explains that onboarding uses a proof-of-possession signature from the offline signer and calls POST /admin/onboard with a real Ed25519 signature. No pre-filled admin identity or signature is present.

steps.action: Inspect steps 2 and 3 and the payment-slips section, still without clicking or entering data.
steps.expectedResult: Step 2 is "Public static publishing URL" and is marked "Waiting on step 1"; its setup controls are disabled. Step 3 is "Live-status web API endpoint" and is marked "Waiting on step 2"; its save control is disabled. The empty payment-slips section says "First-launch setup is incomplete." and states that slip intake is disabled until the admin wallet, static publisher URL, and live-status API endpoint are wired.

steps.action: Open the Connections navigation item without granting ConfigGate, AdminGate, or any sidecar slot.
steps.expectedResult: The page headed "Connections" renders the real capability-grant surface. It truthfully reports the unconfigured state and offers the product controls for granting configuration and AdminGate capabilities; merely viewing the page creates no sturdyref, sidecar lease, invoice, or external request.

launchProbe.expectedResult: A fresh CyberTeller grain launches into its fail-closed, three-step owner setup flow. It requires a real signed admin-wallet onboarding before static publishing can be configured, requires static publishing before the live-status endpoint can be saved, and keeps payment-slip intake disabled while those prerequisites are absent. The bounded probe performs no onboarding, capability grant, sidecar call, invoice creation, settlement, or money movement.

fixtures.name: Signed-in grain owner
fixtures.purpose: Prove the release launches through the normal account-owned Sandstorm surface and exposes only the product's real first-launch controls.
fixtures.setup: Open the new grain from a signed-in Melusina owner account. Do not use an anonymous share link, paste an admin key, or invoke a shell method directly.

fixtures.name: Intentionally unconfigured fresh grain
fixtures.purpose: Prove the release reports its dependency ordering honestly and does not present payment intake as ready before its signed admin and platform capability setup exists.
fixtures.setup: Do not onboard an admin wallet, set up static publishing, save a web API endpoint, claim ConfigGate or AdminGate, create an invoice, or contact any sidecar. This launch probe is intentionally bounded before every external effect.

steps: Move only the temporary acceptance-test grain to Sandstorm Trash through its visible grain menu after the probe completes.
No admin identity, static publisher, web API endpoint, capability sturdyref, invoice, audit event, chain transaction, or money state was created by this read-only probe.
